Authenticate your device

agrepl uses GitHub Device Flow for secure, local-first authentication. No passwords ever touch our servers.

1

Open your terminal and run:

agrepl auth login
2

Copy the one-time code provided in your terminal.

3

Click the button below to authorize on GitHub.

Open GitHub Device Authorization
